name: How should I choose a qualified contractor for cabin and log home refinishing?

mainEntity.name: How should I choose a qualified contractor for cabin and log home refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for log home refinishing, look for hands-on experience with heavy timber prep, wood preservation, and elastomeric chinking rather than standard house painting. Verify that the contractor has appropriate business licensing, general liability insurance, and strong customer standing, such as BBB accreditation. An owner-operated contractor who leads projects on-site can inspect logs closely for hidden rot, evaluate past coating compatibility, and manage carpentry repairs alongside finish work. Request clear written estimates outlining prep steps, stain products, and expected coats.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an insured contractor with direct timber and chinking experience, clear written prep procedures, and an on-site lead who can handle wood repairs alongside staining.
